# Integration Test Infrastructure Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Create the shared test infrastructure used by all integration tests, including assertion helpers, deterministic generators, and the repository-local compile-fail harness.

**Architecture:** `tests/common/` owns reusable helpers. `tests/compile_fail_tests.rs` owns the harness entry point plus the repository-local compile-fail runner. Individual `tests/compile-fail/ui/*.rs` files hold the negative compilation cases.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, std, integration tests, repository-local compile-fail harness

**Design Docs:** `design/28-tests.md` §5.1-§5.3 (shared helpers), §8.22 (numeric comparison tiers), §8.25.1-§8.25.3 (helper internals), Appendix A.5 (compile-fail harness)

**Prerequisites:** W21 must be complete.

Create `tests/common/assertions.rs` with the following content:

```rust
use xenon::dimension::Dimension;
use xenon::element::{CastTo, ComplexScalar, RealScalar};
use xenon::storage::Storage;
use xenon::tensor::TensorBase;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct MathTolerance {
    pub max_abs: f64,
    pub max_rel: f64,
    pub max_ulp: u64,
}

pub trait ExactRealTestScalar: RealScalar {
    type Bits: Copy + Eq + core::fmt::Debug;

    fn to_bits(self) -> Self::Bits;
    fn ulp_distance(self, other: Self) -> u64;
}

impl ExactRealTestScalar for f32 {
    type Bits = u32;

    fn to_bits(self) -> Self::Bits {
        f32::to_bits(self)
    }

    fn ulp_distance(self, other: Self) -> u64 {
        ulp_distance_f32(self, other)
    }
}

impl ExactRealTestScalar for f64 {
    type Bits = u64;

    fn to_bits(self) -> Self::Bits {
        f64::to_bits(self)
    }

    fn ulp_distance(self, other: Self) -> u64 {
        ulp_distance_f64(self, other)
    }
}

fn ordered_bits_f32(value: f32) -> i32 {
    let bits = value.to_bits() as i32;
    if bits < 0 { i32::MIN - bits } else { bits }
}

fn ordered_bits_f64(value: f64) -> i64 {
    let bits = value.to_bits() as i64;
    if bits < 0 { i64::MIN - bits } else { bits }
}

fn ulp_distance_f32(a: f32, b: f32) -> u64 {
    ordered_bits_f32(a).abs_diff(ordered_bits_f32(b)) as u64
}

fn ulp_distance_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> u64 {
    ordered_bits_f64(a).abs_diff(ordered_bits_f64(b)) as u64
}

fn scalar_to_f64<A: CastTo<f64>>(value: A) -> f64 {
    CastTo::<f64>::cast_to(value).expect("test helper requires CastTo::<f64>::cast_to support")
}

fn ulp_eq_f64_with_tolerance(a: f64, b: f64, tolerance: MathTolerance) -> bool {
    let abs_diff = (a - b).abs();
    let scale = a.abs().max(b.abs()).max(1.0);
    abs_diff <= tolerance.max_abs
        || abs_diff <= tolerance.max_rel * scale
        || ulp_distance_f64(a, b) <= tolerance.max_ulp
}

fn math_eq_f64(a: f64, b: f64, tolerance: MathTolerance) -> bool {
    if a.is_nan() && b.is_nan() {
        return true;
    }

    ulp_eq_f64_with_tolerance(a, b, tolerance)
}

/// Assert two real-valued tensors are exactly equal on the same execution path.
pub fn assert_tensor_exact_real<A, D>(
    actual: &TensorBase<impl Storage<Elem = A>, D>,
    expected: &TensorBase<impl Storage<Elem = A>, D>,
    msg: &str,
) where
    A: ExactRealTestScalar,
    D: Dimension,
{
    assert_eq!(
        actual.shape(),
        expected.shape(),
        "{}: shape mismatch: {:?} vs {:?}",
        msg,
        actual.shape(),
        expected.shape()
    );

    for (idx, (a, e)) in actual.iter().zip(expected.iter()).enumerate() {
        let a_native = *a;
        let e_native = *e;
        assert!(
            a_native.to_bits() == e_native.to_bits() || a_native.ulp_distance(e_native) == 0,
            "{}: element {} differs: actual={:?}, expected={:?}, comparison=strict native-type ULP==0",
            msg,
            idx,
            a,
            e
        );
    }
}

/// Assert two complex tensors are exactly equal per component on the same execution path.
pub fn assert_tensor_exact_complex<A, D>(
    actual: &TensorBase<impl Storage<Elem = A>, D>,
    expected: &TensorBase<impl Storage<Elem = A>, D>,
    msg: &str,
) where
    A: ComplexScalar,
    A::Real: ExactRealTestScalar,
    D: Dimension,
{
    assert_eq!(
        actual.shape(),
        expected.shape(),
        "{}: shape mismatch: {:?} vs {:?}",
        msg,
        actual.shape(),
        expected.shape()
    );

    for (idx, (a, e)) in actual.iter().zip(expected.iter()).enumerate() {
        let a_re = a.re();
        let a_im = a.im();
        let e_re = e.re();
        let e_im = e.im();

        assert!(
            a_re.to_bits() == e_re.to_bits() || a_re.ulp_distance(e_re) == 0,
            "{}: element {} real part differs: actual={:?}, expected={:?}, comparison=strict native-type ULP==0",
            msg,
            idx,
            a_re,
            e_re
        );
        assert!(
            a_im.to_bits() == e_im.to_bits() || a_im.ulp_distance(e_im) == 0,
            "{}: element {} imaginary part differs: actual={:?}, expected={:?}, comparison=strict native-type ULP==0",
            msg,
            idx,
            a_im,
            e_im
        );
    }
}

/// Assert two real-valued tensors stay within a documented cross-path tolerance.
pub fn assert_tensor_close_real_cross_path<A, D>(
    actual: &TensorBase<impl Storage<Elem = A>, D>,
    expected: &TensorBase<impl Storage<Elem = A>, D>,
    tolerance: MathTolerance,
    msg: &str,
) where
    A: RealScalar + CastTo<f64>,
    D: Dimension,
{
    assert_eq!(
        actual.shape(),
        expected.shape(),
        "{}: shape mismatch: {:?} vs {:?}",
        msg,
        actual.shape(),
        expected.shape()
    );

    for (idx, (a, e)) in actual.iter().zip(expected.iter()).enumerate() {
        let a_f = scalar_to_f64(*a);
        let e_f = scalar_to_f64(*e);
        assert!(
            ulp_eq_f64_with_tolerance(a_f, e_f, tolerance),
            "{}: element {} differs: actual={}, expected={}, comparison=cross-path tolerance defined by 需求说明书 §28.3 and implemented via 00-coding.md §7.4",
            msg,
            idx,
            a_f,
            e_f,
        );
    }
}

/// Assert math-function results stay within the per-function documented tolerance.
pub fn assert_tensor_close_real_math<A, D>(
    actual: &TensorBase<impl Storage<Elem = A>, D>,
    expected: &TensorBase<impl Storage<Elem = A>, D>,
    tolerance: MathTolerance,
    msg: &str,
) where
    A: RealScalar + CastTo<f64>,
    D: Dimension,
{
    assert_eq!(
        actual.shape(),
        expected.shape(),
        "{}: shape mismatch: {:?} vs {:?}",
        msg,
        actual.shape(),
        expected.shape()
    );

    for (idx, (a, e)) in actual.iter().zip(expected.iter()).enumerate() {
        let a_f = scalar_to_f64(*a);
        let e_f = scalar_to_f64(*e);
        assert!(
            math_eq_f64(a_f, e_f, tolerance),
            "{}: element {} differs: actual={}, expected={}, comparison=math-function tolerance",
            msg,
            idx,
            a_f,
            e_f,
        );
    }
}

macro_rules! assert_xenon_error {
    ($expr:expr, $variant:pat) => {
        match $expr {
            Err($variant) => {}
            Err(other) => panic!("expected {}, got {:?}", stringify!($variant), other),
            Ok(value) => panic!("expected error {}, got Ok({:?})", stringify!($variant), value),
        }
    };
}

pub(crate) use assert_xenon_error;
```

```rust
use xenon::prelude::*;

pub fn standard_shapes_2d() -> Vec<(usize, usize)> {
    vec![(0, 0), (1, 1), (1, 5), (5, 1), (3, 4), (4, 3), (8, 8), (64, 64)]
}

pub struct NonContiguous2D {
    pub owner: Tensor2<f64>,
}

impl NonContiguous2D {
    pub fn view(&self) -> TensorView2<'_, f64> {
        self.owner.transpose()
    }
}

pub fn non_contiguous_2d(rows: usize, cols: usize) -> NonContiguous2D {
    NonContiguous2D {
        owner: Tensor2::<f64>::from_shape_vec(
            [cols, rows],
            (0..cols * rows).map(|idx| idx as f64).collect(),
        )
        .expect("shape and data length must match"),
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the repository-local harness entry point and helper implementation**

Create `tests/compile_fail_tests.rs` with the following content:

```rust
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::Command;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
struct CompileFailCase {
    path: &'static str,
}

impl CompileFailCase {
    fn assert_compile_fail(&self, deps_dir: &Path, xenon_rlib: &Path) {
        let status = Command::new("rustc")
            .arg(self.path)
            .arg("--edition=2024")
            .arg("--crate-name")
            .arg("compile_fail_case")
            .arg("--extern")
            .arg(format!("xenon={}", xenon_rlib.display()))
            .arg("-L")
            .arg(format!("dependency={}", deps_dir.display()))
            .status()
            .expect("compile-fail case should invoke rustc");

        assert!(
            !status.success(),
            "expected compile-fail case {} to be rejected by rustc",
            self.path
        );
    }
}

fn collect_compile_fail_cases() -> [CompileFailCase; 8] {
    [
        CompileFailCase { path: "tests/compile-fail/ui/wrong_dimension_type.rs" },
        CompileFailCase { path: "tests/compile-fail/ui/missing_element_bound.rs" },
        CompileFailCase { path: "tests/compile-fail/ui/mismatched_storage_type.rs" },
        CompileFailCase { path: "tests/compile-fail/ui/unsigned_tensor_element_rejected.rs" },
        CompileFailCase { path: "tests/compile-fail/ui/invalid_unsigned_element_rejected.rs" },
        CompileFailCase { path: "tests/compile-fail/ui/ui_bool_sum_rejected.rs" },
        CompileFailCase { path: "tests/compile-fail/ui/ui_bool_unique_rejected.rs" },
        CompileFailCase { path: "tests/compile-fail/ui/ui_bool_arithmetic_rejected.rs" },
    ]
}

fn deps_dir() -> PathBuf {
    Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("target/debug/deps")
}

fn xenon_rlib(deps_dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    std::fs::read_dir(deps_dir)
        .expect("target/debug/deps should exist after cargo build --lib")
        .filter_map(|entry| entry.ok().map(|value| value.path()))
        .find(|path| {
            path.file_name()
                .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
                .map(|name| name.starts_with("libxenon") && name.ends_with(".rlib"))
                .unwrap_or(false)
        })
        .expect("compiled xenon rlib should exist before running compile-fail cases")
}

#[test]
fn compile_fail_harness() {
    let build_status = Command::new("cargo")
        .args(["build", "--quiet", "--lib"])
        .status()
        .expect("cargo build --lib should run before compile-fail checks");
    assert!(build_status.success(), "cargo build --lib must succeed before compile-fail checks");

    let deps_dir = deps_dir();
    let xenon_rlib = xenon_rlib(&deps_dir);

    for case in collect_compile_fail_cases() {
        case.assert_compile_fail(&deps_dir, &xenon_rlib);
    }
}
```
